Dear ImGui v1.92.9
commit 01380c579715e62fb9a8d6ec0502c4ea83bfde6e
https://github.com/ocornut/imgui

Vendored rather than a submodule: this is a pedalboard, and building one
should not need network access. Only what we use is here -- the core,
plus the SDL2 platform backend and the SDL_Renderer2 rendering backend.
The demo, docs, examples, and the other dozen backends are not.

To update: copy the same file list from a new tag and re-run the tests.
